title: Compose and stress-test the answer to asymmetry

answer_constitution.name: timely_notice_and_direct_voice
answer_constitution.minimum_mechanism: A person or accountable representative receives usable notice before an avoidable consequential action and may submit relevant facts without retaliation.
answer_constitution.failure_mode: Notice arrives only after action or voice is received as nonbinding feedback.

answer_constitution.name: evidence_inspection_and_correction
answer_constitution.minimum_mechanism: The rights holder can inspect the material data, rule, version, threshold, provenance, user action and rationale and compel timely correction of relevant error.
answer_constitution.failure_mode: The institution controls the operative record or correction does not reach downstream copies and decisions.

answer_constitution.name: automatic_pause_and_institutional_burden
answer_constitution.minimum_mechanism: A contestable action pauses before irreversible consequence unless the institution proves a bounded emergency exception to an independent authority.
answer_constitution.failure_mode: The subject must obtain extraordinary litigation after harm or the emergency exception becomes the ordinary route.

answer_constitution.name: binding_reversal_and_remedy
answer_constitution.minimum_mechanism: An independent authority can reverse, prohibit, restore, delete, compensate or otherwise remedy the consequence and its residual effects.
answer_constitution.failure_mode: A formal appeal exists without timely, affordable and effective relief or without correction of the underlying system.

answer_constitution.name: durable_substitution_and_public_capacity
answer_constitution.minimum_mechanism: The system or vendor can be replaced while preserving data, schema, workflow, users, accreditation, responsibility, service continuity and public accountability.
answer_constitution.failure_mode: Exit changes the contract or logo while preserving hidden custody, lost capability or dependency on another private layer.

answer_constitution.name: represented_party_co_governance
answer_constitution.minimum_mechanism: Affected people, through an accountable and removable representative constitution, hold enforceable authority over purpose, category, threshold, acceptable use, exception or termination.
answer_constitution.failure_mode: Representation is advisory, captured, centralized away from affected people, bypassed technically or unable to bind the operator.

answer_constitution.name: proportionate_value_recovery
answer_constitution.minimum_mechanism: Public institutions and affected parties receive enforceable ownership, return, license, IP, compensation, governance or institutional-capacity rights proportionate to authority, data, labor, risk, error, injury and operational learning supplied.
answer_constitution.failure_mode: Aggregate repayment, tax revenue, symbolic upside or public accounting is mistaken for affected-party recovery or just distribution.

composition_requirements: name the rights holder, represented population, operator, public authority and independent counter-sovereign
define the sequence, triggers and dependencies among R1 through R7
preserve source data, model or rule version, threshold, exception, user action, rationale and rejected alternatives
allocate the burden of proof before and after action
define bounded emergency authority, expiry, review and compensation
define representative selection, removal, minority protection, conflict and anti-capture rules
define technical anti-bypass and successor-system rules
define funding, staffing and public operating capacity
define measurable works, regression and stopping standards

lanes.title: Compose the R1–R7 answer constitution
lanes.terminal_contract: Freeze one explicit constitution with a named holder, trigger, record, compulsory mechanism, remedy, bypass test and domain route for every R-level.

lanes.title: Test administrative benefits and automated burden
lanes.terminal_contract: Adjudicate the composed answer against one exact administrative system and one affected-person chain without importing K.W. or Robodebt protections by analogy.

lanes.title: Test surveillance, enforcement, and system prohibition
lanes.terminal_contract: Test pre-action standing, preservation, restraint, correction, deletion, compensation, prohibition and successor-system control in one exact coercive deployment.

lanes.title: Test workplace-monitoring co-governance and bypass
lanes.terminal_contract: Determine whether bounded R6 authority survives centralization, outsourcing, cloud updates, organizational change and technical substitution.

lanes.title: Test public-platform exit, substitution, and capacity
lanes.terminal_contract: Require observed independent operation, continuity, rights, staffing, deletion, performance and accountability rather than formal exit language.

lanes.title: Transfer-test public value recovery in AI, defense, and data finance
lanes.terminal_contract: Close contribution to enforceable residual right to observed realization to distribution in at least one candidate sector, or terminate the transfer.

lanes.title: Repair source ecology v2 and run cross-domain regression
lanes.terminal_contract: Re-run the same 96-route denominator after serialized GDELT and basin-specific repairs, then preserve answer-regression results without conflating source health and answer effectiveness.
